_comment: Baseline that only falls for two-organisation coverage. 'accepted_uncovered' is the number of NON-startup route families that read organisation data yet have no family-targeted two-organisation test today. The gate fails when the non-startup uncovered count rises above this number, so the number can only be lowered as families gain coverage. Startup families (account, admin connectors, intelligence, applications, admin billing, admin team, dashboard) must always be 0 uncovered regardless of this baseline. Lower this when you cover a family; never raise it.
